Listed below are the main places to stay, namely hotels, all of which also provide meals. This is not an exhaustive list: operators who wish to be added to it are invited to contact us. Bear in mind that reaching these establishments may involve even significant detours; we therefore recommend checking their location in advance.

Please note that the promoters of the project have no agreement of any kind with hoteliers and other operators, nor do they derive any advantage – direct or indirect, material or immaterial – from users making use of the services these provide.

We have not included in the list the accommodation from Ruta onwards and in all the places located on the coast or otherwise within the Parco del M. di Portofino: in these parts, in fact, you will be spoilt for choice.

We do, however, give details of the unequipped huts. In keeping with one of the fundamental aims of the project, we nevertheless strongly advise you to favour overnight stays in an equipped establishment: besides obvious reasons of comfort and hygiene (the huts have neither beds nor showers), visiting places without leaving anything to the operators who keep them alive amounts – however unintentionally, of course – to an act that is in fact predatory, one that does not reward the rural and mountain world for the positive externalities it creates through the work of those who bring it to life; not to mention the risk of missing out on many opportunities for encounters and exchanges with locals and other travellers. Bear in mind, too, that the condition of the huts is not guaranteed: they are generally open, but whether they are usable should be checked beforehand with the municipalities in whose territory they lie.

In any case, please remember that wild camping is strictly prohibited along the entire route.
